Now, the private detective she had hired and her ex-footballer boyfriend are going to find her murderer... if they don't kill each other first. But the more they dig, the deeper they become enmeshed in a web of extortion, blackmail and corrupt politics hidden beneath the surface of professional football.

films.summary: Three steelworkers enlist in the army and are sent to Vietnam, one leaving behind a rushed marriage, the others a shared love. What they encounter during the war changes their lives forever.

films.summary: In the ruins of a strange city, a young girl takes care of a large egg she holds carefully in her arms. She bonds with a boy who is searching for a bird he saw in a dream.

films.summary: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

films.summary: Smith, a typical young college student who likes partying and engaging in acts of random sex and debauchery, has been having some interesting dreams revolving around two gorgeous women -- and is shocked when he meets the dream girls in real life. Lorelei looks just like his fantasy brunette, while a mysterious red-haired girl being chased by assassins draws him into an international conspiracy. Or is it all just a drug-induced hallucination?

films.summary: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

films.summary: The tender, heartbreaking story of a young man’s struggle to find himself, told across three defining chapters in his life as he experiences the ecstasy, pain, and beauty of falling in love, while grappling with his own sexuality.

films.summary: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

Sonny and Sal attempt a bank heist which quickly turns sour and escalates into a hostage situation and stand-off with the police. As Sonny's motives for the robbery are slowly revealed and things become more complicated, the heist turns into a media circus.

films.summary: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">INNOCENT SORCERERS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ANDRZEJ WAJDA // 1960</text></svg>

films.title: Ashes and Diamonds
films.summary: A young academy soldier, Maciek Chelmicki, is ordered to shoot the secretary of the KW PPR. A coincidence causes him to kill someone else. Meeting face to face with his victim, he gets a shock. He faces the necessity of repeating the assassination.  He meets Krystyna, a girl working as a barmaid in the restaurant of the "Monopol" hotel. His affection for her makes him even more aware of the senselessness of killing at the end of the war. Loyalty to the oath he took, and thus the obligation to obey the order, tips the scales.

films.summary: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

films.title: Heart of the Beast
films.summary: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

films.title: Days of Heaven
films.summary: In 1916, a Chicago steel worker accidentally kills his supervisor and flees to the Texas panhandle with his girlfriend and little sister to work harvesting wheat in the fields of a stoic farmer.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAYS OF HEAVEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">TERRENCE MALICK // 1978</text></svg>

films.title: Super 8
films.summary: In late 1970s Ohio, a group of friends filming a homemade zombie movie witness a devastating train derailment. Soon after, their quiet town is gripped by unexplained disappearances, strange phenomena, and a growing sense of fear, as they uncover that something terrifying has been set loose.

ABRAMS // 2011</text></svg>

films.title: Lotna
films.summary: Set in the beginning of World War II, when the Polish cavalry still fought with lances against German troops, the movie is about a white thoroughbred horse that passed through various hands in a military outfit.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">LOTNA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ANDRZEJ WAJDA // 1959</text></svg>

films.title: Heathers
films.summary: A girl who halfheartedly tries to be part of the "in crowd" of her school meets a rebel who teaches her a more devious way to play social politics: by killing the popular kids.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HEATHERS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">MICHAEL LEHMANN // 1989</text></svg>

films.title: Ulysses' Gaze
films.summary: An exiled filmmaker finally returns to his home country where former mysteries and afflictions of his early life come back to haunt him once more.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ULYSSES' GAZE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">THEO ANGELOPOULOS // 1995</text></svg>

films.title: Nostos: The Return
films.summary: At the end of the war, Odysseus, the wandering hero, with his companions begins his sail back home to the Mediterranean. The conclusion of his adventure is delayed by many natural obstacles and he takes an internal journey of fleeting memories of his childhood, his parents, love for a beautiful girl, nostalgia for the past, regret for what he did, and the deep silence that envelops everything. He confronts the most terrible loneliness following a shipwreck in which all the comrades perish.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NOSTOS: THE RETURN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">FRANCO PIAVOLI // 1990</text></svg>

films.title: Forgotten Island
films.summary: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FORGOTTEN ISLAND</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">JANUEL MERCADO // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Filipiñana
films.summary: While working at an elite country club outside Manila, a 17-year-old Ilocana worker uncovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past after attempting to return a lost golf club to the club's president.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FILIPIÑANA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">RAFAEL MANUEL // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Invisible Adversaries
films.summary: Set in contemporary Vienna, the film involves a photographer, Anna, who discovers that extraterrestrial beings are colonizing the minds of her fellow citizens by raising the human aggression quotient. The outer world immediately becomes disjointed, yet the inner world does too, as Anna and her lover, Peter, try to hang onto their deteriorating relationship.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">INVISIBLE ADVERSARIES</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">VALIE EXPORT // 1977</text></svg>

films.title: Oasis
films.summary: A young man released from prison visits the widow of the man he killed drunk-driving and becomes infatuated with his cerebral palsy-stricken daughter.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">OASIS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">LEE CHANG-DONG // 2002</text></svg>

films.title: The Invite
films.summary: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE INVITE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">OLIVIA WILDE // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The History of Concrete
films.summary: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE HISTORY OF CONCRETE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">JOHN WILSON // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Free Leonard Peltier
films.summary: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">FREE LEONARD PELTIER</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JESSE SHORT BULL // 2025</text></svg>

films.title: Oedipus Rex
films.summary: In pre-war Italy, a young couple have a baby boy. The father, however, is jealous of his son - and the scene moves to antiquity, where the baby is taken into the desert to be killed. He is rescued, given the name Oedipus, and brought up by the King and Queen of Corinth as their son. One day an oracle informs Oedipus that he is destined to kill his father and marry his mother. Horrified, he flees Corinth and his supposed parents - only to get into a fight and kill an older man on the road…
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">OEDIPUS REX</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">PIER PAOLO PASOLINI // 1967</text></svg>

films.title: On the Beach
films.summary: In a summer in Shonan village, Sumiko is the daughter of an important upper-class Shikishima family, she loves to paint pictures, is going through a cooling-off of an arranged marriage that did not work out. However, she feels attraction for Nishina a rough and obscene man ...  On the other hand, the younger sister, Naomi Sumiko is envious of her sister for her beauty. Naomi feels ugly since all men seem to like Sumiko. Both sisters then become embroiled in a major problem in discovering the real intentions of Nishina, a man who hides behind a mask to rape women.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ON THE BEACH</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">JUNICHI SUZUKI // 1985</text></svg>

films.title: A Face in the Crowd
films.summary: The rise of a raucous hayseed named Lonesome Rhodes from itinerant Ozark guitar picker to local media rabble-rouser to TV superstar and political king-maker. Marcia Jeffries is the innocent Sarah Lawrence girl who discovers the great man in a back-country jail and is the first to fall under his spell.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">A FACE IN THE CROWD</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ELIA KAZAN // 1957</text></svg>

films.title: Stella Dallas
films.summary: A working-class woman is willing to do whatever it takes to give her daughter a socially promising future.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">STELLA DALLAS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">KING VIDOR // 1937</text></svg>

films.title: Concessions
films.summary: As the Royal Alamo Cinema closes its doors for good, jaded staff, eccentric patrons, and an unhinged manager stumble through one last night at the movies—grappling with busted dreams, bad popcorn, and hard goodbyes.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">CONCESSIONS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">MAS BOUZIDI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Pushing Hands
films.summary: Mr. Chu is an elderly widower who teaches tai chi chuan in Beijing. He moves to America to live with his son's family, but finds the cultural adjustment difficult. Since his daughter-in-law is a white woman who does not speak Chinese, Mr. Chu's son, Alex, must mediate.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">PUSHING HANDS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">ANG LEE // 1991</text></svg>

films.title: Electra, My Love
films.summary: It has been fifteen years since the death of her father, Agamemnon, and Elektra still burns with hatred for Aegisztosz, who conspired with Elektra's mother to kill him.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">ELECTRA, MY LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MIKLÓS JANCSÓ // 1974</text></svg>

films.title: Verity
films.summary: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">VERITY</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">MICHAEL SHOWALTER // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: No Skin Off My Ass
films.summary: A lonely hairdresser watches the title sequence of "That Cold Day in the Park" then visits a local park to invite a down-and-out skinhead to his apartment. He draws the silent man a bath and talks to him as he soaks. He locks his guest in a bedroom. Next day, the skinhead leaves through the window and visits his sister, who's making a film called "Sisters of the SLA." He helps with a screen-test. The hairdresser has dreams and fantasies involving the skinhead, the skinhead returns to visit him, and then the filmmaker pays a call on the two men, exposing her brother as faking his silence and pretending a lack of sexual interest. Fantasies can come true.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NO SKIN OFF MY ASS</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">BRUCE LABRUCE // 1991</text></svg>

films.title: Hen
films.summary: Escaping from a chicken farm, a hen finds refuge in the courtyard of a crumbling restaurant. There, she discovers love, confronts the pecking order, and fights to protect her eggs from a greedy owner. Her droll yet touching quest for motherhood mirrors the messy compromises and silent struggles of human lives.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">HEN</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">GYÖRGY PÁLFI // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Practice of Love
films.summary: Judith is a maverick reporter who is also seeking a satisfying relationship with various men. She finds corruption and power-games everywhere.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE PRACTICE OF LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">VALIE EXPORT // 1985</text></svg>

films.title: Small Change
films.summary: It's the run up to prom night for Leila and her friends in the Garw Valley. With money tight, and the pressures of the cost of living weighing heavy on her shoulders, will it stop Leila's celebration?
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#06090c"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">SMALL CHANGE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#e5a93c" text-anchor="middle">MALI HARRIES // 2022</text></svg>

films.title: Never After Dark
films.summary: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">NEVER AFTER DARK</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">DAVE BOYLE // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Musical
films.summary: Doug, a frustrated playwright and middle school theater teacher, learns his ex is dating his nemesis, the school principal. To get revenge and cost him a Blue Ribbon Award, Doug secretly stages the most inappropriate play imaginable.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE MUSICAL</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">GISELLE BONILLA // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: The Last First: Winter K2
films.summary: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="11" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">THE LAST FIRST: WINTER K2</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">AMIR BAR-LEV // 2026</text></svg>

films.title: Ryuichi Sakamoto: CODA
films.summary: Oscar-winning composer Ryuichi Sakamoto weaves man-made and natural sounds together in his works. His anti-nuclear activism grew after the 2011 Fukushima disaster, and his career only paused after a 2014 cancer diagnosis.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#0c0608"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#e5a93c" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RYUICHI SAKAMOTO: CODA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#8b93a6" text-anchor="middle">STEPHEN NOMURA SCHIB // 2017</text></svg>

films.title: Rape of Love
films.summary: Nicole, nurse in Grenoble, is raped one night by four men. Deeply scarred, emotionally and physically, she thinks she will never recover from the trauma. Following a friend's advice, she decides to file a lawsuit.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#04080e"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#00e5bc" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">RAPE OF LOVE</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">YANNICK BELLON // 1978</text></svg>

films.title: Medea
films.summary: Medea after having helped the man she loves, Jason, and given him to birth two children, is driven into fury and vengeful madness after he decides to abandon her to become successor to the throne by marring Glauce, the daughter of Creon, king of Corinth.
films.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="200" height="300" fill="#080507"/><circle cx="100" cy="100" r="48" fill="#ff2a4b" opacity="0.8"/><text x="100" y="238" font-family="Instrument Serif, serif" font-size="14" fill="#f3ebd7" text-anchor="middle">MEDEA</text><text x="100" y="260" font-family="JetBrains Mono, monospace" font-size="7" fill="#00e5bc" text-anchor="middle">LARS VON TRIER // 1989</text></svg>

films.title: The Misconceived
films.summary: A failed filmmaker turned single dad tries to make a living while retaining his sense of self, in James N. Kienitz Wilkins’ experimental 3D-rendered home renovation comedy, which doubles as an acidic treatise on working conditions for the contemporary creative.

films.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
films.summary: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail.

films.title: Notorious
films.summary: "Notorious" is the story of Christopher Wallace. Through raw talent and sheer determination, Wallace transforms himself from Brooklyn street hustler (once selling crack to pregnant women) to one of the greatest rappers of all time: The Notorious B.I.G. Follow his meteoric rise to fame and his refusal to succumb to expectations - redefining our notion of "The American Dream."

films.title: Daughter's Daughter
films.summary: Jin is in her 60s. Her husband gone, her concern is for daughter Zuer, in New York trying out IVF with her partner Michelle. When Jin receives news that Zuer and Michelle have died in an accident, she heads for NY. There, she has another shock: she has inherited Zuer’s embryo and it’s for her to decide its fate. Meanwhile, going to NY also forces Jin to face Emma, the daughter she gave up for adoption when she was 17.
